basis.analysis: Linear-elastic 2D frame, direct stiffness, Euler-Bernoulli members, gross concrete sections, E = Ecm
basis.combinations: EN 1990 Eq. (6.10) with pattern loading; recommended psi factors

steps.expression: neutral axis depth from the compressed face (strain compatibility)
E_{s}·ε_{s} ≤ f_{yd} with ε_{s} = -25.88 ‰ (bars at depth 48 mm)
E_{s}·ε_{s} ≤ f_{yd} with ε_{s} = 0.69 ‰ (bars at depth 502 mm)

Span 1.title: Shear

steps.expression: effective depth to the top (tension) reinforcement
chosen in [1, 2.5] to maximise min(V_{Rd,s}, V_{Rd,max})

notes: Checked at every station, including at the support axis (conservative; 6.2.1(8) allows d from the face).

Span 1.title: Clear bar spacing, bottom
notes: Assumes one layer of bars across the width.

Span 1.title: Clear bar spacing, top
notes: Assumes one layer of bars across the width.

Span 1.title: Span/depth ratio (deemed to satisfy)

steps.expression: K·[11 + 1.5·√f_{ck}·ρ_{0}/(ρ − ρ') + (1/12)·√f_{ck}·√(ρ'/ρ_{0})], ρ' taken as 0 (conservative; the equation is singular as ρ' → ρ)

notes: Uses the provided reinforcement and omits the 310/σ_s factor, both conservative.

Span 1.title: Long-term deflection (quasi-permanent)

steps.expression: 1 − β·(M_{cr}/M_{qp})^{2}, β = 0.5, at the governing station
∫ κ·m̄ dx with κ = ζ·κ_{II} + (1 − ζ)·κ_{I} (relative to the member chord)

notes: Moments from the linear-elastic analysis (no redistribution from cracking).
Shrinkage curvature (7.4.3(6)) is not included; add a margin or check it separately.
